admission_measurements: Measured 20 nature nodes, 81 rows, 307 cells. Focused 6-test suite results are recorded in the S35 handoff; opposing provenance never clamps. Memory ceiling and provider capacity remain unmeasured and clinical release is blocked awaiting review.
assumptions: No clinical model or history definition approved.

Effect present/absent/not_assessed is an explicit applicability input; an absent case is not_applicable with no posterior claim, never a negative finding or a fake negative review posterior; unresolved or not_assessed pauses for clarification.
All 20 BN-12 distributions were missing and are synthetic uniform references here; complete clinical table provenance remains a release blocker.

Full SAS item responses are measurement context only when the complete reviewed source is available; no etiology is inferred from an unreviewed SAS total or mean, the up-to-0.3 convention and the 0.7 screening proposal are review candidates only, and no universal mild/moderate/severe bands are created from historical thresholds; SAS complete-source approval and concrete item/completeness/severity/network definitions remain open.

Effect severity is an independent clinician-reviewed category, never derived from SAS total or mean bands; no treatment threshold is set here and no dose, route, frequency or active/stopped fields are set here.
Whether review outputs behave as deterministic rules or estimated tables is an open assumption for owner review; this draft uses estimated-table semantics without approval.

Fever, altered consciousness, autonomic instability or severe generalized rigidity requires urgent NMS evaluation rather than attribution to uncomplicated parkinsonism; the parallel urgent banner comes from saved structured inputs independently of estimation latency and BN-12 carries no urgent network node by design.

Onset, medication-timeline, alternative-cause, tardive-differential, dose-feasibility, switch-feasibility, psychotic-worsening, preference, anticholinergic safety, amantadine safety, NMS-triage and prophylaxis operationalization require owner review.

numerical_examples: examples.json contains one complete independently worked 20-node mathematical reference: Indication 0.3/0.4/0.3, Regimen 0.042/0.06/0.09/0.09/0.018/0.7 with a Dose/Switch transpose guard (swapped gives ReviewDose 0.09 and ReviewSwitch 0.06), AnticholinergicSafety 0.349/0.651 with a SafetyConcern/OtherBurden transpose guard (swapped gives 0.284), Symptomatic 0.075/0.09/0.135/0.7 with a Tardive/Preference transpose guard (swapped gives TardiveDifferential 0.12), Continuation 0.225/0.225/0.55 with a Use Yes/No guard (swapped gives Lowest 0.275), Amantadine 0.24/0.06/0.7, Prophylaxis 0.125/0.5/0.375 with a Prior Yes/No guard (swapped gives Exceptional 0.375). Two opposing projections of the same CPT yield identical posteriors, proving no clamping. This validates math and engineering only; clinical expected_for_review cases remain unapproved.
